notes: Eclipse Loop 1.6.1 Fixed: metallic noise on arranger track plugin inserts. Loading any plugin insert on an arranger track and hitting PLAY SONG could produce a metallic fizz/static. The track-1 insert chain was being processed twice per audio block (once by the arranger, once by the main-loop path), which modulated the plugin's output at the audio block rate. The two paths are now mutually exclusive, so inserts run once per block and sound clean. Bounced/exported songs were never affected. Also hardened the transport reported to hosted plugins so transport/tempo-aware inserts see a consistent play state. --- Note: after installing, macOS may reset the ON AIR screen-recording permission (it is pinned to each build). If ON AIR recording is silent, toggle Eclipse Loop OFF then ON in System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Screen & System Audio Recording, then quit and reopen the app.
